column1: # Capture targets: node hash <TAB> page path
# From Roogle's MeshRank leaderboard, which ranks pages by how much of the mesh
# links to them, discounted for node size. Using an existing index rather than
# crawling means we discover without probing, which is the first rule in
# ONE REQUEST PER NODE. These are fetched once and frozen. That is well inside
# the one-per-day limit the network asks for, and it is the whole point: a
# frozen snapshot is worth more to us than a live one.
# ouroboros git is the interesting one for generated Micron: an rngit node
# builds its pages from a repository, so its output is machine-made.
